At the stop line it was flagged offroad, only about 0.7 m from where the human drove.

It was only 0.6 m from the human's path, so this looks like a marginal clip of the mapped boundary rather than a clear departure.

It closed from 32 m to 1.4 m on parked car 6 while only slowing from 14.6 to 12.3 m/s, and hit it with its front.

The metrics table shows no front or side collision and the lead car was more than 30 m ahead, so the failure is the ego leaving the drivable area, not a crash.
